cluster_definition.member_geometry: 18 transformation views (brightness 0.7/1/1.3 x blur 0/0.8 x rotation -20/0/20) x 2 fixed fixture crops (prepare_fixture in scripts/run_measured_benchmark.py)
cluster_definition.pairing: within-member: both arms (M and C) scored on the SAME rendered view

pinning_procedure.content_pin: SHA-256 of the exact image bytes, recorded in the frozen fixture manifest (schema d2-0005-fixture-manifest 1.0) BEFORE arming, exactly as source-zidane.jpg is pinned today
pinning_procedure.frozen_before: arming; any change after freeze requires a new pre-arming amendment under the section 7 deviations policy

independence_criteria: images are sourced independently of the candidate pipeline and of every model in PERSON-SUR-v3 and PERSON-HO-v3
no image may be selected, rejected, or weighted on the basis of any measured outcome (selection is outcome-blind)
no two base images may be near-duplicates, crops, or transformed variants of one another (distinct photographic sources)
no base image may overlap the surrogate optimization or any prior-generation evaluation fixture

rehearsal_gate.metric: realized ICC via the ANOVA rho-hat diagnostic of cluster_paired_arm_statistics.intracluster_diagnostics
rehearsal_gate.gate: ICC <= 0.25 confirmed BEFORE arming; if realized ICC materially exceeds 0.25, K must be raised by a further pre-arming amendment (ICC ~ 0.5 requires K ~ 144, disclosed design-effect extrapolation) BEFORE arming
rehearsal_gate.zero_variance_behavior: rho-hat reported NA (null) at zero total variance, never 0 (red-team finding F7)

unmodeled_dependence_disclosure: cross-model same-image correlation and view-level ICC heterogeneity are NOT modeled in the sizing study; they are absorbed into the within-cluster member structure at analysis time and bounded by the mandatory rehearsal ICC measurement gate
provenance_disclosure: K = 72 is a disclosed grid pick from K in {8, 12, 18, 24, 36, 72} of the pre-arming cluster OC study (artifacts/design_analysis_d20005_cluster/results.json, schema 2.0), the smallest simulated cluster count achieving P(SUCCESS) >= 0.8 at delta_true = +0.2 under ICC = 0.25; the choice is conditioned on the ICC <= 0.25 assumption enforced by the rehearsal gate
